simple.meaning: לְבָאוֹת (Lᵉbâʼôwth) is a Hebrew word meaning “Lebaoth , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לְבָאוֹת (H3822) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in לְבָאוֹת (H3822) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: לְבָאוֹת (Lᵉbâʼôwth) / H3822 is traced through Joshua 15:32 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

Site unknown. לבב (meaning dubious; Dl Pr. 88 ff. finds original meaning in Assyrian lab'bu, in unruhiger Bewegung sein; — √ of לֵב לֵבָב, ; compare Late Hebrew id. , Assyrian libbu, Aramaic לִבָּא Ethiopic Arabic Sabean לב , SabDenkm p. 13, No. 1, 1. 7 ); — the literary usage of לֵב and לֵבָב is: 1 earliest poetry, J and E chiefly, Ephr document of Judges/Samuel/Kings chiefly, Amos, Hosea, Zechariah 9-11, Isaiah 15 use לֵב . 2 לֵבָב first appears in Isaiah and certain strata of E and Ephr document of Judges Samuel Kings, and is continued in Zephaniah, Nahum (probably) D H Deuteronomy editors and some Psalms 3 Jeremiah Ezekiel Job prefer לֵב but use occasionally לֵבָב . 4 Isa 2 , Isa 3 , Lamentations and exilic Psalms use לֵב . 5 Isaiah 13-14:23; Jeremiah 50-51, Haggai, Zechariah 1-8, Joshua, Jonah, Psalm 25, 90, 104, use לבב . 6 Malachi, Obadiah, Zechariah 12-14, Memorials of Ezra and Nehemiah, Proverbs, Ruth, Canticles and many Psalms of Persian period use לֵב . 7 Chronicles and Daniel use לֵבָב . 8 Ecclesiastes Esther and latest Psalms use לֵב .
